verdict.rationale: Cerebras dedicated endpoints explicitly support deploying custom fine-tuned models alongside standard variants on reserved capacity (cerebras-docs-9, cerebras-docs-10, cerebras-docs-24), covering the 'serve' half of the story. However, there is no evidence that Cerebras itself provides a fine-tuning service/API — the docs imply fine-tuning happens elsewhere and the resulting model is uploaded/deployed to a dedicated endpoint, not that the platform trains it. missing for 10: an actual fine-tuning API/pipeline on Cerebras, documentation of supported base models for tuning, and any hands-on confirmation of the full fine-tune-then-serve workflow.
